changes: Transcribed by hand from the vendor PDF, per the ADR-013 procedure (two independent readings that must agree). Exactly ONE removal: mfg=Linear_Systems, which ngspice evaluates as an expression and dies on - 'Undefined parameter [linear_systems]', 'ERROR: fatal error in ngspice', exit 1. Verified in this lotto rather than inherited from L6. Nothing else changed: no value rounded, reordered or corrected, and the vendor's own parenthesis placement '.model LS350 (PNP ...' is kept verbatim even though ngspice prints 'warning, model type mismatch in line' for it - the canonical form was run side by side and produced identical numbers to seven significant figures.
reason: T7 (ADR-016) requires a manufacturer SPICE model for every active device in the signal path. The input current mirror was a THAT320, which is end-of-life (T8) - NC-015, blocking. ADR-018 selects the Linear Systems LS352, a monolithic dual PNP of the LS350 series, as its replacement. This file is the model that makes the mirror simulable.
notes: MIXED VERDICT against the vendor's own datasheet, measured at its conditions at 25 C: hFE 441.2 / 483.2 / 490.6 at 10 uA / 100 uA / 1 mA (window 200..600, INSIDE), COBO 1.584 pF (2 pF max, INSIDE), NF 0.325 dB at RG = 10 k (3 dB max, INSIDE), but fT 129.5 MHz at IC = 1 mA against a 200 MHz MINIMUM - 35% OUTSIDE, checked on three agreeing legs. The model is SLOWER than the guaranteed part, so HF figures computed with it are pessimistic; that is the safe direction but not a known amount. Recorded as NC-020. NOISE: input-referred 1.685 nV/rtHz at IC = 1 mA, VCB = 10 V, 1 kHz - 2.22x (+6.9 dB) worse than the THAT320's QPNP_THAT_NS measured 0.758 nV/rtHz on the same deck. Cause is RB = 200 with IRB = 1e-05 and BF = 500, so base resistance sits near RB, not near RBM = 10; the THAT320 carried RB = 25. The datasheet promises only NF <= 3 dB at RG = 10 k, which permits ~12.8 nV/rtHz, so 1.685 nV/rtHz is what the MODEL says and not a part guarantee. NO KF/AF, therefore NO 1/f noise - same gap as every other model in this repo except the LSK489 (NC-004). One model per part: Linear Systems publishes a single SPICE model for the whole LS350/LS351/LS352 series, so limitations.md #17 (a vendor shipping two different models of one part) does not apply here - checked, not assumed. The model is named LS350 while the project buys the LS352 grade: same die, different tested grade, so this model describes the die and cannot vouch for the grade's matching window.
